welcomeSurveys:
Welcome to Surveys

Create structured polls with single-choice, multi-choice, rating, and text questions. One response per participant; control who sees results with visibility and PIN settings.

Select a survey from the list, or click **+ New Survey** to get started.

**Welcome to Townhall Q&A Poll**

Ask questions, vote on what matters most, and have your voice heard. Questions with the **most votes** get priority attention.
